**Session / topic:** IRLS for negative binomial

## What I did
Hand-coded IRLS for the negative-binomial GLM with an offset.

## What I learned
IRLS is Fisher scoring, and the working weights carry the variance structure.

## Difficulties and open questions
Convergence was fragile with the dispersion parameter free.

## What I will do next
Profile the dispersion and decay parameters.
